description.value:
You can replenish your chakra a limited number of times each day — your endurance, not your peak power. You start with 1 daily use of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllChargChakra0]{Charge Chakra} focus spell. Various clan heritages, feats, and effects increase this number, representing a deeper or fresher chakra well.

Track your remaining uses with the Chakra Reserves resource. You can spend a Charge Chakra use once per Refocus (10-minute rest) provided you still have daily uses remaining.

TODO: when the module ships a Chakra Reserves resource tracker on the actor sheet, this feature will register it via a rule element. For now the counter is GM-tracked.
